text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Gold Ship-san, happy birthday to you 
today.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Huh? Nah, it ain't my birthday, though.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
My birthday ended three years ago, didn't 
it? On that day when an awfully 
clam-scented wind blew. What are you 
saying—

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Gasp! Don't tell me... the "crazy ones" 
have made their move...?

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
D-Dangerous folks...? Whatever do you mean 
by that, Sir?!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
"They're a bunch trying to stimulate the 
economy by leaking fake birthday dates and 
getting people to send presents over and 
over...!"

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it they're tied up with them 
"bad dudes" too... Unforgivable! That's 
just unforgivable, ain't it, Mame-chin!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
Mmh... I can't quite wrap my head around 
what's happening...!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
However... if there truly exists an 
organization spreading false information, 
this officer cannot overlook it!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Alright, time to play Syndicate Busters! 
Consider that your birthday present to me!

text_block_list.name: Fenomeno
text_block_list.text:
"...Huh? So in the end, your 
birthday...?!"
